b.x: 0 h off the grid, if you marked zero
The clock does not predict a flood. If you live near a river, the hour to leave is the one you already wrote in the plan, not an invented warning.

When the network falls, the device becomes a tool. It does not ask for GPS. It does not send what you wrote anywhere. The map of your street does not come inside it: you write the three routes before, on paper and here. The red light, the whistle, and the compass are already in the tools. The aid is already on the red tab. This mode joins the clock, the count, and the signal. You mark day zero. It counts the hours. It does not predict a river flood. If you live near water, the flood is written by you, not by the application. The ration count: liters, calories, people. It says how many days the numbers you typed will last. It is not an order to starve. Whoever already has an illness follows the doctor. Three liters a person remains the water minimum when the heat tightens. Cutting water to 'last longer' makes you sick. The signal is a pattern you agreed before: short and long, in the light and in a low sound. The check phrase stays behind the password, on this device. It does not prove the other person is who they say. Whoever saw the screen knows the signal. It is not a message. It does not cross the street by itself. The diary, if you set a password, stays closed on this device. Forget the password, the diary does not open. The routes and the clock do not stay behind the password. Aid does not stay behind a password. The layer of the day suggests what to open. It does not hide the rest. On day one you can already read the water and the fire. Waiting until day eight to learn to boil is late. The dark mode of this page does not multiply the battery. A site does not turn off the phone radio, does not stop an update, and does not turn one day of charge into ten. Lower the brightness by hand. Close what is not this page. The real light is the one with a battery. The knowledge that does not spoil is on the other tabs: filter, fire, shelter, the pack, the two routes, the foot. This mode is the pocket that points to them.
